paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, divided into five bins.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of a variable labeled "Pass@1" in terms of percentage representation across defined categories. The horizontal axis presents the categories labeled "Pass@1" with a scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, appearing in intervals of 0.2. The vertical axis is labeled "Percentage" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, marked in intervals of 0.1. The chart contains five bars, each representing a specific category: bar from 0.0 to 0.2 is 11.2% height, bar from 0.2 to 0.4 is 3.4%, bar from 0.4 to 0.6 also at 3.4%, bar from 0.6 to 00.8 at 5.8%, and bar from 0.80 to 1.0 reaching about 76.2%, which is the tallest. There is a red dashed vertical line at the value of "Pass@1" equal to 0.82, accompanied by the text "mean: 0.82" in red near the upper portion of the chart at 0.6 percentage. No specific order or visual emphasis beyond the described annotations is identified in the arrangement of bars, aside from the placement of the percentage labels at the top of each bar. All bars are of the same light blue color.
